description: Implementation of a generic AT command handling library for Bluetooth subsystem in Zephyr RTOS, including parsing, command processing, and response handling.

methods.name: next_list
methods.description: Advances the list pointer if current character is a comma.

methods.name: at_check_byte
methods.description: Checks if the first byte in buffer matches the expected byte and pulls it.

methods.name: skip_space
methods.description: Skips spaces in the at_client buffer.

methods.name: at_get_number
methods.description: Parses a number from the buffer, skipping spaces.

methods.name: str_has_prefix
methods.description: Checks if a string has a specific prefix.

methods.name: at_parse_result
methods.description: Parses the AT command response result (OK or ERROR).

methods.name: get_cmd_value
methods.description: Extracts command value until stop byte.

methods.name: get_response_string
methods.description: Extracts response string until stop byte.

methods.name: at_state_start
methods.description: Initial state handler, checks for carriage return.

methods.name: at_state_start_cr
methods.description: Checks for newline after carriage return.

methods.name: at_state_start_lf
methods.description: Checks for '+' or alpha to determine next state.

methods.name: at_state_process_result
methods.description: Processes command result, calls finish callback.

methods.name: at_parse_input
methods.description: Main parser for AT input buffer.

methods.name: at_has_next_list
methods.description: Checks if more list items are present.

methods.name: at_list_get_range
methods.description: Extracts range of numbers from list.
